info.title: Caring for Earwax the Right Way
info.subtitle: From leaving it alone to when the clinic helps

rows.title: Wax is protective
rows.desc: It traps debris and guards the canal skin

rows.title: Clean the outer ear only
rows.desc: A washcloth beats any tool in the canal

rows.title: Skip swabs and candling
rows.desc: Both push wax deeper or injure the ear

rows.title: Soften stubborn wax
rows.desc: Drops or mineral oil help it drain out

rows.title: Let a pro clear blockages
rows.desc: In-clinic removal is quick and gentle
